name: react-dom
description: A fake 'react-dom' package for the react-addon node-lane e2e: its nearest package.json name is 'react-dom', so wpd's package resolver attributes these frames to react-dom and the server-phase anchor rollup fires. Not real react-dom; it just carries the anchor NAMES the rollup keys on, so the addon path is exercised end-to-end from a clean checkout with no install.
